description: Genomic feature(s) related to the variant. NOTE: Although genes could also be referenced using these attributes, they have an independent section to allow direct queries.

featureId.description: Stable identifier of genomic feature, preferably in CURIE format (e.g. HGNC:11998, ENSEMBL:ENSG00000141510). For anonymous or interval-derived features, a locally minted identifier MUST be used.

genomicInterval.description: Genomic interval of the genomic feature, uses the VRS schema for the coordinates and adds the strand

aliases.description: Human-readable names or symbols commonly used for this feature (gene symbols, transcript names, or other aliases).

xrefs.description: Cross-references of the genomic feature. CURIE format is recommended.

featureType.description: Ontology term that describes the type of genomic feature. Values from SO (Sequence ontology) are recommended, e.g. `SO:0001623: 5 prime UTR variant`

ontologyTerms.description: Ontology terms of the genomic feature like biological functions, molecular effects, etc.

relationship.description: Object representing the hierarchical relationships of the genomic feature like gene -> transcript -> exon. It is recommended to use the featureId of the parent and children as CURIE format. Locally minted identifiers are also allowed.

parent.description: Parent of the genomic feature, usually a gene or transcript

children.description: Children of the genomic feature, usually a transcript or exon

title: GenomicFeature
